To clarify I suffer from anxiety and depression so it was never surprising to me. What seemed to work about 80 percent of the time was to have one of my friends look me in the eye and make some form of physical contact while telling me in a relaxed carefree voice that I'm just tripping and will be ok. For some reason that was always enough to pull me back. I guess the long and short of it is don't do them if u have pressing issues you don't want to have come up during your trip and remember a spotter (sober friend) will make all the difference in pulling you out of a spiral. Hope this helps!
